Home/Portfolio/Children's Sleepwear UGC Ad

AI UGC

Children's Sleepwear UGC Ad

A thirty-eight second vertical UGC ad opening on a parent at bedtime, moving through the garment in hand, fabric and stitch detail, the set worn, and closing on a caption block with the product details and handle.

Client
Kaelani's Baby Essentials
Category
AI UGC
Role
AI Video Creator & Video Editor
Objective

Sell a children's clothing product through a routine a parent recognises rather than a product description.

Deliverables
  • Vertical UGC ad
  • Product detail sequence
  • Caption chips and closing block
  • Social export
The challenge

What the project needed to solve.

Children's clothing is bought on fabric, safety and wash durability — details that need to be seen up close — but the ad still had to feel like a parent sharing something rather than a brand selling. Balancing the close product detail against the domestic warmth is where this format usually tips one way or the other.

The solution

Concept, script, AI production, edit.

The ad is structured around the routine: a time stamp on screen sets the scene, the garment is handled the way a parent actually handles it, and only then does the camera go close on the cotton and the stitching. Specification appears as a caption chip rather than a voiceover claim. The closing text block carries the full detail for anyone who watched to the end.

Tools used
  • Kling AI
  • HeyGen
  • ElevenLabs
  • CapCut
Production process
  • Discovery
  • Research & Concept
  • Scriptwriting
  • AI Production
  • Editing & Refinement
